llm_response.reason: Extensive warnings across social/video/social media platforms confirm scam behavior: non-delivery, spoofing a reputable shoe brand, no verifiable contact info, fake pre-order offers, unusually enticing prices, and direct community reports of being scammed. These behaviors match several established scam indicators (impersonating a real company, targeting urgency, fake offers, ambiguous business presence), making it a textbook example of a Fake Online Shopping scam.
